buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED BID SPECIFIC ATC 1. Tender Inviting Authority This tender is issued by the Director, ICMR-National Institute of Translational Virology and AIDS Research ( NITVAR), Pune, Maharashtra, for the procurement of one (1) unit of High Performance Computer as p er the specifications provided in the Specification PDF attached with the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC. 2. Bid Security Declaration In accordance with Rule 170 of the GFR, 2017, the Bid Security Declaration shall apply. MSEs registered un der the MSME Procurement Policy and DPIIT-recognized Startups shall be exempt from payment of EMD, s ubject to submission of valid and applicable registration documents for the relevant trade group and within the prescribed monetary limits. 3. Eligibility Criteria Bidders must be either:

(a) Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs); or (b) Authorized agents/dealers/distributors of the OEM. 4. One Bid per Bidder Only one bid shall be permitted from each bidder, whether participating individually or as part of a joint ve nture. Submission of multiple bids by the same bidder shall result in disqualification. 5. Right to Cancel The Director, ICMR-NITVAR reserves the right to cancel the tender, in part or in full, at any stage without a ssigning any reason thereof. The decision of the Competent Authority in this regard shall be final and bindi ng. 6. Inspection and Tests ICMR-NITVAR or its designated representative reserves the right to inspect and/or test the goods supplied to verify conformity with the specifications and other requirements of the contract. The supplier may also be required to conduct additional quality tests at its own cost, wherever deemed necessary. 7. Acceptance Certificate The goods shall be inspected upon delivery, installation, testing, and commissioning. An Acceptance Certificate shall be issued by ICMR-NITVAR only upon satisfactory completion of inspection and verification of conformity with the prescribed specifications and contractual requirements. 8. Packing Requirements The goods shall be securely packed to prevent damage during handling, transportation, and storage. The p ackaging shall: (a) Be adequate to withstand handling, climatic, storage, and transportation conditions; and (b) Comply with all applicable marking, labeling, and documentation requirements. The packing condition may be inspected prior to dispatch and/or upon receipt at the consignee location. 9. Payment Terms 100% payment shall be made after successful delivery, installation, testing and commissioning, inspection and acceptance of the goods by ICMR-NITVAR, and submission of the Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG), wherever applicable. Payment shall be subject to applicable statutory deductions, including taxes, liquidated damages, penaltie s, or deductions arising due to non-rectification of defects or deficiencies. The following documents shall be submitted for processing of payment, as applicable: Copy of Purchase Order/Contract; Extension Order, if applicable; Original Invoice clearly indicating the relevant contract/Purchase Order details; Consignee Receipt/Delivery Challan; Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG), wherever applicable; and Any other documents required under the GeM Bid/Contract. 10. Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) Performance Bank Guarantee shall be applicable as per the terms and conditions specified in the GeM Bid/ Contract. 11. Dispute Resolution (a) Any dispute or difference arising out of or in connection with the contract shall, in the first instance, be resolved amicably through mutual consultation between the parties. (b) In the event that the dispute is not resolved amicably within 30 days, the same may be referred to arb itration in accordance with the applicable laws and contractual provisions. (c) The arbitration shall be conducted on the following basis: Appointing Authority: Director, ICMR-NITVAR Venue: Pune, Maharashtra Language: English Applicable Law: The contract shall be governed by the applicable laws of India, including the provi sions of the Commercial Courts Act, 2015, as amended from time to time, wherever applicable. (d) During the pendency of arbitration proceedings, the supplier shall continue to perform its contractual o

bligations, unless otherwise directed by the Competent Authority. 12. Insurance The goods shall be adequately insured against risks associated with transit, storage, handling, and delivery up to the consignee location. The insurance coverage shall remain valid for a period of three (3) months after delivery. In the event that commissioning is delayed for reasons not attributable to the supplier, the additional insur ance extension cost, if any, shall be reimbursed as per applicable contractual provisions. The insurance shall provide coverage of 110% of the shipment value up to the consignee location. 13. Liquidated Damages In case of delay in delivery attributable to the supplier, Liquidated Damages shall be levied at the rate of 0 .5% of the contract value per week or part thereof, subject to a maximum of 10% of the contract value. Applicable taxes/GST, as per Government of India regulations, shall be deducted additionally, wherever ap plicable. 14. GST and Taxes GST and other applicable taxes shall be governed by the prevailing Government of India regulations. The rates quoted by the bidder shall be inclusive of GST, all applicable taxes, duties, charges, and customs duties, if any, as applicable up to the consignee location, unless specifically provided otherwise in the GeM Bid. 15. Debarred/Blacklisted Firms Bidders who have been blacklisted, debarred, suspended, or otherwise prohibited from participating in pro curement by any Government Organization or by the GeM Portal, as on the date of bid submission, shall b e ineligible to participate in this GeM Bid. 16. Definition of Delivery For the purpose of this tender, delivery shall mean complete supply, installation, testing, and commissioni ng of the equipment at ICMR-NITVAR, Pune, in accordance with the prescribed specifications and contra ctual requirements. 17. Make in India (MII) Policy The bidder shall comply with the applicable provisions of the Government of India Make in India (MII) Policy . Declaration of local content and details of Indian collaboration, wherever applicable, shall be mandatory i n accordance with the prevailing Government of India policy. 18. Contract Splitting Contract splitting shall not be applicable for this tender. The complete quantity shall be considered as o ne procurement requirement. 19. Technical Compliance Bidders shall submit the following along with their bid: (a) Point-wise compliance against each specification mentioned in the attached Specification PDF; (b) Supporting technical brochures/catalogues/data sheets; and (c) Website references or other relevant technical literature, wherever applicable. Note: In the event of any discrepancy between the generic parameters/specifications available on the Ge M Portal and the specifications contained in the Specification PDF attached with the Buyer Added Bi d Specific ATC, the specifications provided in the attached Specification PDF shall prevail. 20. Precedence of Buyer Added ATC Conditions In the event of any discrepancy or inconsistency between the standard GeM Bid Terms and Conditions and the conditions specified in this Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC, the provisions of this Buyer Added Bid Sp ecific ATC shall prevail, to the extent permissible under the applicable GeM terms and Government rules. 21. Delivery Location The complete Delivery, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning (DITC) of the equipment shall be c arried out at: ICMR-National Institute of Translational Virology and AIDS Research (NITVAR), Pune, Maharash tra.

The supplier shall ensure that the equipment is fully operational and commissioned at the above location i n accordance with the prescribed technical specifications and contractual requirements. 22. Discrepancy Clause In the event of any discrepancy, inconsistency, or conflict between the specifications, terms, and condition s mentioned in the GeM Bid and those specified in the Specification Document/Specification PDF atta ched under the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC, the provisions of the Specification Document/Speci fication PDF shall prevail and shall be binding on the bidder/supplier. The bidder shall be deemed to ha ve examined and understood the Specification Document before submission of the bid and shall comply wi th the specifications contained therein. 23. After-Sales Service The supplier shall provide after-sales service for a period of 5 years, including the supply of required spar es and software support/updates, as applicable. 24. Turnaround Time (TAT) The supplier shall ensure a maximum Turnaround Time (TAT) of 48 hours for attending to service/sup port requests. . 2.
